mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates strengthening economic fundamentals, which drives positive equity market sentiment and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 shows a quarterly increase (vs. prior quarter).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a robust labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below a 2% monthly drop threshold signals an imminent supply shock that disrupts corporate supply chains and reduces earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls > 2.0% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases and RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized) signals an environment where the Federal Reserve is likely to implement aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO shows a monthly increase.
